title: kit.kit-source.v1
description: The kit at t=0 (docs/FRESHNESS.md): what scripts/kit.mjs verified before a use of the kit: what is at vendor.path is the kit at the published head (kit.kit-head.v1) with no local edit: the published archive unpacked and verified by sha256 (transport archive) or a clean git checkout at that HEAD (transport git), with the kit's dependencies installed from its lockfile and linked into node_modules. Written to <path>/node_modules/.kit-source-record.json by every ensure; a refusal writes nothing.

repository.description: the kit repository the checkout tracks (kit.canon.json vendor.repository, default the kit's)

sha.description: the checkout's HEAD: equal to published.sha or the record does not exist

published.description: the published head object it was verified against (the URL the kit's registry names)

installed.description: the kit's dependencies are installed from the lockfile of this very HEAD

linked.description: the links made in this ensure (node_modules/@saasreport, node_modules/.bin/kit); absent on a verify

transport.description: how the kit was brought to path: the published archive (no credential) or a git checkout

then.$comment: equality of sha and published.sha is enforced by the bootstrap (a mismatch is a refusal, never a record)
